enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Armor Mastery +2: Passive: +2 Enhancement bonus to the Max Dex Bonus of your equipped light, medium, or heavy armor. This benefit does not apply to the Max Dex Bonus of a Tower Shield.
Shield Proficiency: Tower Shield: While equipped this item grants the feat Shield Proficiency: Tower Shields.
Deathblock: The wearer of this item is immune to all death spells and magical death effects.
Fortification +100%: +100% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
Regeneration: Causes the wearer to regenerate 1 hit point a minute using positive energy.
True Seeing: Passive: You gain the benefit of the spell True Seeing.
